title: Second parity correlation under conjunction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Choose sign vectors $x,y\in\{\pm1\}^n$ independently and uniformly, and form their coordinatewise Boolean conjunction $x\wedge y$, equal to $-1$ exactly where both signs are $-1$. The expected product of the parity of $y$ on $S$ and the parity of $x\wedge y$ on $S$ is $(\frac12)^{|S|}$.
